question: After the correctness defects are repaired, should this export layer be restacked onto the revised agent-centric RFC model, intentionally preserve the earlier flat-entry prototype, or pause until the Claws foundation settles?
rationale: The latest RFC explicitly replaces this branch's schema and lifecycle assumptions, while the protected label reserves final product acceptance for human review.

options.title: Restack safely to the revised RFC
options.body: Carry forward only portable, collision-safe export mechanics after the grouped `claws add` foundation is accepted.

options.title: Preserve the earlier prototype
options.body: Explicitly approve the flat-entry export/apply contract and own its migration obligations after fixing the defects.

options.title: Pause the export layer
options.body: Defer or close this layer if restacking is premature or not worth maintaining.

recommendation.title: Restack safely to the revised RFC
recommendation.body: Carry forward only portable, collision-safe export mechanics after the grouped `claws add` foundation is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the product-model review that drove the RFC rewrite and are the strongest available routing candidate for confirming whether the earlier prototype remains acceptable.
